# India Post DIGIPIN attribution

This is an unmodified copy of the India Post reference engine from
https://github.com/INDIAPOST-gov/digipin/blob/main/src/digipin.js.
Verified source Git blob: `02a89afa066a30f5cf2a55dbc2a64e7964efbf30`.
Retain its original source comments and the accompanying Apache-2.0 LICENSE.
Developed by the Department of Posts with IIT Hyderabad and NRSC, ISRO.

PinID invokes this algorithm locally; location coordinates are not transmitted
to the separate DIGIPIN API. DIGIPIN identifies a geographic grid cell, not
residence, identity or ownership. PinID does not claim India Post affiliation.
Changes to the vendored algorithm require provenance/license review and running
the published vectors, boundary and round-trip tests in this folder.
